rate_card.retrieval_method: Official OpenAI documentation search and fetched pricing/model pages
rate_card.long_context_rule: Above 272000 input tokens: 2x input/cache rates and 1.5x output on the whole request.
rate_card.status: Rate card observed on this date; not an actual subscription invoice or a guarantee of prices on the implementation dates.

limitations: Observed September 21 rate card, not proof of historical invoice rates.
